BiblicalUsage: The Preacher names youth itself with this word, the dawning of life before the years weigh on it. Remove sorrow from thy heart, he says, and put away evil from thy flesh, for childhood and youth are vanity.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that youth is a gift that passes like the dawn, and the Preacher is right to call it vanity when it is spent on itself.
